**Windows:** download `Mentis-<version>-setup-x64.exe` and run it (no administrator rights needed).
A copy installed with the installer updates itself: it asks at startup.

**Linux:** download `Mentis-<version>-x86_64.AppImage`, make it executable
(`chmod +x Mentis-*.AppImage`) and run it. It needs a system with glibc 2.35 or newer (Ubuntu 22.04
and later, or a distribution of the same age). Mentis tells you at startup when a new version is out.

**macOS:** download `Mentis-<version>-macos.dmg`, open it and drag Mentis into Applications (macOS 12
or newer, Apple silicon and Intel). The app is not notarized yet: the first time, open it with
right-click > Open, or allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway. Mentis tells you
at startup when a new version is out.

`SHA256SUMS` lists the files' checksums.

[Code signing policy](https://github.com/simozock/Mentis#code-signing-policy)
